_note: Racing beyond cars (src/app/racing/<sport>; the lobby, entry fees, prizes and dead heats are the Autodrome's, src/data/autodrome/entry.json). Each racer picks a mount from the venue's stable or paddock (no need to own one): horses at Meydan, camels at Al Marmoom, superbikes at the Autodrome. Each mount trades one strength for another, so the rider's race craft decides it. Horses and camels: top is the flat-out speed (km/h) when pushed, accel how quickly it gets there (m/s²), stamina how many seconds of pushing it has before it tires, agility how well it holds a line in the bends. Superbikes: top (km/h), accel (m/s²) and grip, ridden like a car (lib/autodrome step). The sport ids, their tracks (src/data/autodrome/tracks.json, by sport) and the mount ids are mirrored in race_sport_rules() (*_horse_camel_bike_racing.sql; checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs).

sports.name: Horse racing
sports.tagline: Ride a thoroughbred on the Dubai World Cup course
sports.blurb: Pick a horse from the Meydan stable, open a race and ride against your friends live. Push too early and your horse fades; save it for the final furlong.

mounts.name: Thunder Road
mounts.blurb: A sprinter: the quickest away and the fastest flat out, but he empties his tank early.

mounts.name: Desert Crown
mounts.blurb: A stayer: a little slower at the top, with stamina to push from a long way out.

mounts.name: Silver Mirage
mounts.blurb: All-rounder: good speed, good stamina, steady in the bends.

mounts.name: Midnight Falcon
mounts.blurb: Nimble: hugs the rail through the turns like no other, so he saves ground every bend.

sports.name: Camel racing
sports.tagline: Race the desert's fastest camels, robot jockeys and all
sports.blurb: Pick a racing camel, open a race and drive your robot jockey from the 4x4 alongside, live against your friends. Camels have stamina to burn: the race is won by the one who pushes at the right time.

mounts.name: Bint Al Reeh
mounts.blurb: "Daughter of the wind": the fastest when she's pushed, but she tires sooner than the others.

mounts.name: Al Asfar
mounts.blurb: A stayer from the old bloodlines: never the quickest, never tired.

mounts.name: Najmat Al Layl
mounts.blurb: "Star of the night": quick off the line and steady round the bends.

mounts.name: Mubaraka
mounts.blurb: The all-rounder the trainers love: good at everything.

sports.name: Superbike racing
sports.tagline: 300 km/h superbikes on the Autodrome's five circuits
sports.blurb: Take a superbike from the paddock, open a race and go knee-down against your friends live. Bikes pull harder than any car, but they have less grip, so brake before the bends.

mounts.name: Ducati Panigale V4 R
mounts.blurb: The fastest down the straights, and a handful in the bends.

mounts.name: BMW M 1000 RR
mounts.blurb: Winglets and huge brakes: stable and quick everywhere.

mounts.name: Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10RR
mounts.blurb: World Superbike pedigree: grips and turns better than it pulls.

mounts.name: Yamaha YZF-R1M
mounts.blurb: The sweetest handling in the paddock, the slowest flat out.

mounts.name: Honda CBR1000RR-R Fireblade SP
mounts.blurb: Explodes out of the corners: the best acceleration on the grid.
